conversations.title: A Smooth Ride
conversations.description: Take a taxi to your hotel with no problems.

messages.text: Buongiorno! Benvenuto. Dove la porto oggi?
messages.english: Good morning! Welcome. Where can I take you today?

choices.text: Buongiorno! Mi porti all'Hotel Roma, per favore.
choices.english: Good morning! Take me to Hotel Roma, please.
choices.feedback: Perfect! You stated your destination clearly and politely.

choices.text: Vorrei ordinare una pizza margherita subito.
choices.feedback: You are in a taxi, not a restaurant!

choices.text: Dov'è il binario per il treno veloce?
choices.feedback: This is a taxi stand, not the train station.

messages.text: Certo, via Nazionale 15. Mettiamo le valigie nel baule?
messages.english: Sure, via Nazionale 15. Shall we put the suitcases in the trunk?

choices.text: Sì, grazie. Ho due valigie grandi e uno zaino.
choices.english: Yes, thank you. I have two large suitcases and a backpack.
choices.feedback: Good. It is helpful to tell the driver how many bags you have.

choices.text: No, preferisco dormire in aeroporto stasera.
choices.feedback: But you just asked to go to a hotel!

choices.text: Sì, ma voglio guidare io la macchina.
choices.feedback: The taxi driver must drive the car!

messages.text: Nessun problema. C'è un po' di traffico in centro, va bene?
messages.english: No problem. There is a bit of traffic downtown, is that okay?

choices.text: Va bene. Quanto tempo ci vuole per arrivare?
choices.english: That's fine. How long does it take to arrive?
choices.feedback: Good question! Asking for the duration is very common.

choices.text: Non importa. Voglio comprare delle scarpe.
choices.feedback: Focus on the trip first!

choices.text: Mi sento male, cerco una farmacia aperta.
choices.feedback: Unless it is an emergency, stick to your destination.

messages.text: Circa trenta minuti. Vuole sapere il costo della corsa?
messages.english: About thirty minutes. Do you want to know the cost of the ride?

choices.text: Sì, quanto costa il taxi dall'aeroporto?
choices.english: Yes, how much does the taxi cost from the airport?
choices.feedback: Exactly. It is wise to confirm the price early.

choices.text: No, non ho soldi e non voglio pagare.
choices.feedback: You cannot take a taxi if you don't intend to pay!

choices.text: Sì, mi dica il binario del mio treno.
choices.feedback: You are in a taxi, not at the station.

messages.text: La tariffa è fissa: sono cinquanta euro. È un buon prezzo?
messages.english: The fare is fixed: it is fifty euros. Is it a good price?

choices.text: Sì, è perfetto. Possiamo andare adesso.
choices.english: Yes, it's perfect. We can go now.
choices.feedback: Great, you've agreed on the price.

choices.text: No, preferisco andare a piedi con le valigie.
choices.feedback: It's too far to walk from the airport!

choices.text: Voglio uno sconto del cento per cento.
choices.feedback: That would mean a free ride, which is not possible.

messages.text: Perfetto, partiamo. È la sua prima volta a Roma?
messages.english: Perfect, let's go. Is it your first time in Rome?

choices.text: Sì, è la prima volta. Sono molto emozionato.
choices.english: Yes, it's the first time. I am very excited.
choices.feedback: Nice! Small talk makes the ride more pleasant.

choices.text: No, abito qui da venti anni ormai.
choices.feedback: If you lived here, you probably wouldn't be staying at a hotel.

choices.text: Dov'è la Tour Eiffel, per favore?
choices.feedback: That's in Paris, not Rome!

messages.text: Roma è bellissima. Vuole che accenda l'aria condizionata?
messages.english: Rome is beautiful. Do you want me to turn on the air conditioning?

choices.text: Sì, grazie. Fa un po' caldo oggi.
choices.english: Yes, thank you. It's a bit hot today.
choices.feedback: Good choice for a comfortable ride.

choices.text: No, preferisco il riscaldamento al massimo.
choices.feedback: But it's already hot outside!

choices.text: Voglio un gelato al pistacchio subito.
choices.feedback: The driver can't give you gelato while driving!

messages.text: D'accordo. Siamo quasi arrivati in via Nazionale. Eccoci!
messages.english: Agreed. We have almost arrived at via Nazionale. Here we are!

choices.text: Ottimo. È proprio davanti all'hotel. Si fermi qui.
choices.english: Great. It's right in front of the hotel. Stop here.
choices.feedback: Clear instructions for the driver to stop.

choices.text: Continui a guidare fino a Napoli.
choices.feedback: Naples is very far from Rome!

choices.text: Voglio scendere in mezzo all'autostrada.
choices.feedback: That is very dangerous and illegal!

messages.text: Siamo arrivati. Sono cinquanta euro, come concordato.
messages.english: We have arrived. It's fifty euros, as agreed.

choices.text: Ecco a lei. Può tenere il resto come mancia.
choices.english: Here you go. You can keep the change as a tip.
choices.feedback: Very generous! Drivers always appreciate a tip.

choices.text: Non ho soldi, mi dispiace molto.
choices.feedback: You should have checked your wallet before starting!

choices.text: Dov'è il Colosseo? Non lo vedo.
choices.feedback: You are at your hotel, not the Colosseo.

messages.text: Grazie mille! Le scarico i bagagli. Buona giornata!
messages.english: Thank you very much! I'll unload your bags. Have a nice day!

choices.text: Grazie mille a lei. Buona giornata e arrivederci!
choices.english: Thank you very much. Have a nice day and goodbye!
choices.feedback: A polite way to end the interaction.

choices.text: Voglio dormire ancora un po' in macchina.
choices.feedback: The taxi needs to go to the next customer!

choices.text: Mi aiuti a portare le valigie in camera?
choices.feedback: Taxi drivers usually only unload at the curb.

conversations.title: Paying by Card
conversations.description: Ensure the driver accepts credit cards before starting.

messages.text: Salve! Ha bisogno di un taxi per il centro?
messages.english: Hello! Do you need a taxi to the center?

choices.text: Sì, grazie. Accetta la carta di credito?
choices.english: Yes, thank you. Do you accept credit cards?
choices.feedback: Very important to check payment methods in advance.

choices.text: Sì, ma non ho bagagli con me oggi.
choices.feedback: You forgot to ask about the payment!

choices.text: No, sto aspettando l'autobus numero dieci.
choices.feedback: If you don't need a taxi, the conversation ends!

messages.text: Sì, certo. Accetto tutte le carte. Dove deve andare?
messages.english: Yes, of course. I accept all cards. Where do you need to go?

choices.text: Devo andare in Piazza Navona, al civico dieci.
choices.english: I need to go to Piazza Navona, number ten.
choices.feedback: Great. Giving the specific street number is helpful.

choices.text: Voglio andare a mangiare un gelato adesso.
choices.feedback: Give the driver a specific address first.

choices.text: Cerco un volo per Milano stasera tardi.
choices.feedback: You are leaving the airport, not booking a flight!

messages.text: Piazza Navona, capito. Vuole mettere la valigia nel baule?
messages.english: Piazza Navona, understood. Do you want to put the suitcase in the trunk?

choices.text: Sì, per favore. È una valigia molto pesante.
choices.english: Yes, please. It's a very heavy suitcase.
choices.feedback: Polite and informative.

choices.text: No, la porto io sulle mie gambe.
choices.feedback: Too uncomfortable for a taxi ride!

choices.text: Sì, metta anche il mio cane dentro.
choices.feedback: You didn't mention a dog before!

messages.text: Va bene. Il traffico è scorrevole, arriviamo presto.
messages.english: All right. Traffic is moving well, we will arrive soon.

choices.text: Ottimo. Può dirmi il prezzo approssimativo?
choices.english: Great. Can you tell me the approximate price?
choices.feedback: Good job asking for an estimate.

choices.text: Male. Voglio scendere e camminare ora.
choices.feedback: But you are on the highway!

choices.text: Grazie. Mi dà un menù del ristorante?
choices.feedback: Again, this is a taxi, not a restaurant.

messages.text: Saranno circa quarantacinque euro. Le va bene?
messages.english: It will be about forty-five euros. Is that okay with you?

choices.text: Sì, va bene. È un prezzo onesto.
choices.english: Yes, that's fine. It's a fair price.
choices.feedback: Confirming the price avoids surprises later.

choices.text: No, voglio pagare solo cinque euro.
choices.feedback: That is far too low for this distance.

choices.text: Mi dica l'ora esatta, per favore.
choices.feedback: Focus on the price for now.

messages.text: Bene, allora andiamo. Le piace la musica alla radio?
messages.english: Good, then let's go. Do you like the music on the radio?

choices.text: Sì, mi piace. Che stazione è questa?
choices.english: Yes, I like it. Which station is this?
choices.feedback: Small talk about music is common.

choices.text: No, spenga tutto subito. Voglio silenzio.
choices.feedback: A bit rude, try to be more polite.

choices.text: Preferisco suonare io la chitarra.
choices.feedback: You are a passenger, not the entertainer!

messages.text: È una stazione di musica italiana. Siamo quasi in centro.
messages.english: It's an Italian music station. We are almost downtown.

choices.text: Perfetto. Si vede già la cupola di San Pietro?
choices.english: Perfect. Can you already see St. Peter's dome?
choices.feedback: Asking about landmarks is a great way to practice.

choices.text: No, vedo solo la neve sulle montagne.
choices.feedback: There is no snow in downtown Rome!

choices.text: Voglio andare al mare adesso.
choices.feedback: But you asked for Piazza Navona!

messages.text: Sì, si vede in lontananza. Eccoci a Piazza Navona.
messages.english: Yes, it's visible in the distance. Here we are at Piazza Navona.

choices.text: Che bella! Può fermarsi vicino alla fontana?
choices.english: How beautiful! Can you stop near the fountain?
choices.feedback: Giving a specific spot to stop is helpful.

choices.text: Fermi la macchina in mezzo alla piazza!
choices.feedback: Taxis cannot drive into the middle of the square.

choices.text: Non mi piace, torniamo indietro.
choices.feedback: You have already arrived!

messages.text: Certamente. Sono quarantacinque euro. Prendo la carta.
messages.english: Certainly. That's forty-five euros. I'll take the card.

choices.text: Ecco la mia carta. Mi dà la ricevuta?
choices.english: Here is my card. Can you give me the receipt?
choices.feedback: Good job completing the payment and asking for a receipt.

choices.text: Ho cambiato idea, voglio pagare in contanti.
choices.feedback: You said you wanted to use a card earlier!

choices.text: La carta è scaduta, non funziona.
choices.feedback: That's a big problem!

messages.text: Ecco la ricevuta e la sua carta. Arrivederci!
messages.english: Here is the receipt and your card. Goodbye!

choices.text: Grazie mille per l'aiuto. Arrivederci!
choices.english: Thank you very much for the help. Goodbye!
choices.feedback: A polite conclusion to the trip.

choices.text: Dov'è il mio portafoglio? L'ho perso qui.
choices.feedback: Check your bags quickly!

choices.text: Voglio fare un altro giro della città.
choices.feedback: The driver has other customers waiting.

conversations.title: Double Checking
conversations.description: Make sure the driver has the correct address.

messages.text: Buongiorno. Mi dica pure l'indirizzo della sua destinazione.
messages.english: Good morning. Please tell me the address of your destination.

choices.text: Buongiorno. Devo andare in Via del Corso, numero cinque.
choices.english: Good morning. I need to go to Via del Corso, number five.
choices.feedback: Clear and concise destination info.

choices.text: Buongiorno. Mi piace molto il clima di Roma.
choices.feedback: Small talk is fine, but give the address first!

choices.text: Ciao! Dove posso comprare un biglietto del bus?
choices.feedback: You are talking to a taxi driver!

messages.text: Via del Corso... è vicino a Piazza del Popolo?
messages.english: Via del Corso... is it near Piazza del Popolo?

choices.text: Sì, esatto. È molto vicino alla piazza.
choices.english: Yes, exactly. It is very close to the square.
choices.feedback: Confirming landmarks helps the driver.

choices.text: No, è vicino all'aeroporto di Milano.
choices.feedback: That is hundreds of kilometers away!

choices.text: Non lo so, non conosco la città.
choices.feedback: Try to use your map to help.

messages.text: Ho capito perfettamente. Posso caricare io la sua borsa?
messages.english: I understood perfectly. Can I load your bag?

choices.text: Sì, grazie mille. È molto gentile.
choices.english: Yes, thank you very much. You are very kind.
choices.feedback: Politeness is always appreciated.

choices.text: No, la borsa è vuota e leggera.
choices.feedback: Even if it is light, it should go in the back.

choices.text: Sì, ma faccia attenzione ai miei piatti.
choices.feedback: Why do you have dishes in your bag at the airport?

messages.text: Partiamo subito. Preferisce l'aria condizionata o il finestrino?
messages.english: Let's leave immediately. Do you prefer air conditioning or the window?

choices.text: Preferisco l'aria condizionata, fa molto caldo.
choices.english: I prefer the air conditioning, it's very hot.
choices.feedback: Good choice for a comfortable ride.

choices.text: Voglio scendere dalla macchina adesso.
choices.feedback: You just started the trip!

choices.text: Voglio un bicchiere di acqua fredda.
choices.feedback: The driver is not a waiter.

messages.text: D'accordo. C'è un po' di traffico oggi. Ha fretta?
messages.english: Agreed. There is a bit of traffic today. Are you in a hurry?

choices.text: No, non ho fretta. Posso aspettare.
choices.english: No, I'm not in a hurry. I can wait.
choices.feedback: A calm attitude helps in traffic.

choices.text: Sì, devo essere lì in due minuti!
choices.feedback: That's impossible with this traffic!

choices.text: Non capisco la domanda, parli più piano.
choices.feedback: The question was simple, try to answer.

messages.text: Bene. Passiamo davanti al Mausoleo di Augusto. Lo vede?
messages.english: Good. We are passing in front of the Mausoleum of Augustus. Do you see it?

choices.text: Sì, lo vedo. È un monumento molto antico.
choices.english: Yes, I see it. It is a very ancient monument.
choices.feedback: Recognizing landmarks is good for your orientation.

choices.text: No, sto dormendo con gli occhi aperti.
choices.feedback: That's a bit strange!

choices.text: È un nuovo centro commerciale?
choices.feedback: No, it's a historical monument!

messages.text: Sì, ha più di duemila anni. Siamo quasi arrivati.
messages.english: Yes, it is more than two thousand years old. We have almost arrived.

choices.text: Fantastico. La strada è quella a destra?
choices.english: Fantastic. Is that the road on the right?
choices.feedback: Helping with directions can be useful.

choices.text: No, giri a sinistra verso la luna.
choices.feedback: Stay on the road, please!

choices.text: Voglio fermarmi a comprare un giornale.
choices.feedback: Wait until you reach your destination.

messages.text: No, è la prossima a sinistra. Eccoci al numero cinque.
messages.english: No, it's the next one on the left. Here we are at number five.

choices.text: Perfetto, si fermi pure qui sul marciapiede.
choices.english: Perfect, please stop here on the sidewalk.
choices.feedback: Clear instruction for the driver.

choices.text: Voglio entrare con la macchina nel portone.
choices.feedback: The taxi cannot go inside the building!

choices.text: Siamo nel posto sbagliato, torniamo indietro.
choices.feedback: This is the address you gave!

messages.text: Eccoci. Sono quaranta euro. Vuole pagare in contanti?
messages.english: Here we are. That's forty euros. Do you want to pay in cash?

choices.text: Sì, ecco quaranta euro. Mi dà la ricevuta?
choices.english: Yes, here are forty euros. Can you give me the receipt?
choices.feedback: Paying in cash is simple and direct.

choices.text: No, voglio pagare con un sacco di mele.
choices.feedback: The driver only accepts money!

choices.text: Non pago niente perché il traffico era brutto.
choices.feedback: Traffic is not the driver's fault!

messages.text: Certamente. Ecco la ricevuta. Le auguro un buon soggiorno!
messages.english: Certainly. Here is the receipt. I wish you a pleasant stay!

choices.text: Grazie mille. Arrivederci e buona giornata!
choices.english: Thank you very much. Goodbye and have a nice day!
choices.feedback: A polite goodbye.

choices.text: Mi porti le valigie fino al quinto piano.
choices.feedback: The driver's job ends at the sidewalk.

choices.text: Dov'è la chiave di casa mia?
choices.feedback: Check your pockets, the driver doesn't have it!

conversations.title: Asking for a Receipt
conversations.description: Request a receipt for your business expenses.

messages.text: Buonasera. Dove vuole andare a quest'ora?
messages.english: Good evening. Where do you want to go at this hour?

choices.text: Buonasera. Mi porti in via Veneto, numero venti.
choices.english: Good evening. Take me to via Veneto, number twenty.
choices.feedback: Direct and clear.

choices.text: Buonasera. Ho molta fame, voglio una cena.
choices.feedback: The driver can take you to a restaurant, but give an address.

choices.text: Ciao! Mi dà una mappa della città?
choices.feedback: Drivers have GPS, they don't usually give out paper maps.

messages.text: Via Veneto, molto bene. Ha molti bagagli?
messages.english: Via Veneto, very well. Do you have many bags?

choices.text: Solo una valigia piccola. Posso tenerla con me?
choices.english: Only one small suitcase. Can I keep it with me?
choices.feedback: Good to ask if you can keep a small bag inside.

choices.text: Ho dieci valigie enormi e tre zaini.
choices.feedback: That won't fit in a standard taxi!

choices.text: No, non ho niente, sono povero.
choices.feedback: A bit strange to say!

messages.text: Sì, può tenerla sul sedile. Andiamo!
messages.english: Yes, you can keep it on the seat. Let's go!

choices.text: Grazie. Mi può dire quanto costa la corsa?
choices.english: Thank you. Can you tell me how much the ride costs?
choices.feedback: Always a good idea to know the price.

choices.text: No, voglio andare a piedi adesso.
choices.feedback: You are already in the taxi!

choices.text: Può cantare una canzone per me?
choices.feedback: The driver is not an entertainer.

messages.text: Di notte c'è un supplemento. Saranno sessanta euro.
messages.english: At night there is a surcharge. It will be sixty euros.

choices.text: Capisco. Mi può fare la ricevuta alla fine?
choices.english: I understand. Can you give me the receipt at the end?
choices.feedback: Great. Asking for a receipt ahead of time is smart.

choices.text: Sessanta euro? È un furto, scendo!
choices.feedback: Night rates are higher, but not illegal.

choices.text: Sì, e voglio anche un caffè caldo.
choices.feedback: Focus on the transaction.

messages.text: Certamente, nessun problema. Ha bisogno della ricevuta per lavoro?
messages.english: Certainly, no problem. Do you need the receipt for work?

choices.text: Sì, esattamente. Devo giustificare la spesa.
choices.english: Yes, exactly. I need to justify the expense.
choices.feedback: Explaining why you need it is a good conversation starter.

choices.text: No, voglio solo collezionare pezzi di carta.
choices.feedback: That's an unusual hobby!

choices.text: Sì, per darla al mio gatto come gioco.
choices.feedback: A bit silly!

messages.text: Capisco. È un viaggio d'affari allora?
messages.english: I see. Is it a business trip then?

choices.text: Sì, sono qui per una conferenza importante.
choices.english: Yes, I'm here for an important conference.
choices.feedback: Nice! You are sharing more about your trip.

choices.text: No, sono qui per rubare il Colosseo.
choices.feedback: Don't say that to a Roman!

choices.text: Sì, vendo macchine volanti.
choices.feedback: Maybe in the future!

messages.text: Interessante. Le strade sono libere stasera, arriviamo subito.
messages.english: Interesting. The roads are clear tonight, we'll be there right away.

choices.text: Ottimo. Mi piace viaggiare di notte.
choices.english: Great. I like traveling at night.
choices.feedback: Positive comments make the trip better.

choices.text: Male, voglio stare nel traffico per ore.
choices.feedback: Nobody wants that!

choices.text: Spegni i fari, voglio vedere le stelle.
choices.feedback: The driver must keep the lights on for safety!

messages.text: Eccoci in via Veneto. Dove la lascio esattamente?
messages.english: Here we are in via Veneto. Where exactly shall I drop you off?

choices.text: Mi lasci pure all'angolo, dopo il semaforo.
choices.english: Drop me off at the corner, after the traffic light.
choices.feedback: Precise instructions are very helpful.

choices.text: Mi lasci sul tetto di quel palazzo.
choices.feedback: Taxis don't fly!

choices.text: Non mi lasci mai solo, la prego.
choices.feedback: That's a bit too dramatic!

messages.text: Va bene, mi fermo qui. Sono sessanta euro.
messages.english: All right, I'll stop here. That's sixty euros.

choices.text: Ecco a lei. Mi fa la ricevuta, per favore?
choices.english: Here you go. Can you make me the receipt, please?
choices.feedback: Reminding the driver about the receipt.

choices.text: Non pago perché è troppo tardi.
choices.feedback: The time doesn't excuse you from paying!

choices.text: Le do un bacio invece dei soldi.
choices.feedback: The driver needs money, not kisses!

messages.text: Certamente. Ecco la sua ricevuta. Arrivederci!
messages.english: Certainly. Here is your receipt. Goodbye!

choices.text: Grazie mille e buona serata. Arrivederci!
choices.english: Thank you very much and have a good evening. Goodbye!
choices.feedback: A polite conclusion.

choices.text: Voglio il suo numero di telefono.
choices.feedback: Keep it professional.

choices.text: Dov'è il ristorante più vicino?
choices.feedback: You can look around now that you've arrived.
